_about: Hand-kept facts about each reference document that the build cannot work out: type, title, edition, where it came from, and whether it may be handed to trainees. Keyed by file name; one document per line. tools/contribute.py document adds a line.

distribution_states.SHARE: may be given to trainees (file or print), credit the publisher
distribution_states.FREE_DOWNLOAD: free on the publisher's site; fine in class; on the tablets prefer the publisher's link
distribution_states.INSTRUCTOR_ONLY: licensed or paid copy - for instructors and course building only, never to trainees or the tablets
distribution_states.CHECK: origin or licence not recorded - a person must decide before anyone but instructors sees it
